unblock_procedure.fastest_path: Ready Player Me (~2 minutes, free, no code changes)
steps: Open https://readyplayer.me and create an avatar (or use an existing one).
Choose a SHORT-SLEEVE / bare-arm outfit — the forearm is the cream-application area and must be bare skin.
Download / copy the avatar GLB URL and save the file as simulator/assets/human/human.glb
If it prints PASS, view it: cd simulator && python3 -m http.server 8080 -> http://localhost:8080/human-preview.html?model=human.glb
Record the source/licence in this file, then Phase 2 can start with no code changes.
alternatives: Any CC0/CC-BY rigged human GLB you can legally redistribute
Install Blender so a MakeHuman/MPFB CC0 model can be generated locally
Provide a direct licensed download URL on npm or raw.githubusercontent.com
